_about: Selectable detector registry. The deployed detector is RT-DETR R50 (Apache-2.0), run as ONNX via onnxruntime-migraphx on the AMD MI300X; the RTDETR_ONNX env var picks the model file. The metadata (mAP, speed, tags, license, status) documents the alternatives that were compared. Benchmark = COCO val2017 mAP(50-95) + indicative half-precision end-to-end latency/FPS from each project's paper/repo (mixed sources — MEASURE on our own GPU for the truth). Our 5 kept classes (person/car/truck/motorcycle/bicycle) are all COCO, so every model already knows them.
benchmark_ref: COCO val2017 mAP@[.5:.95]; latency = indicative half-precision, per papers

verdict.commercial_note: every entry here is Apache-2.0 and free to ship in a closed-source commercial product; AGPL/restrictive detector licences need a paid license and are deliberately excluded

models.name: RT-DETR-R50 (Baidu)
models.notes: DEPLOYED. Apache-2.0, NMS-free, strong on crowded/overlapping CCTV scenes. Exported to ONNX [batch,N,6], input 640x640, RGB. Run via onnxruntime-migraphx on the AMD MI300X (ROCm); MIGraphX compiles a .mxr cache on first boot (~9 min) and loads from cache after (~5s). COCO label order verified correct (car/person/motorcycle/truck dominate street cams).

measured.note: batch-28 half precision, infer every 6th frame; healthy confidences (car .81 / person .78). Ample GPU headroom.

models.name: RT-DETR-R101 (Baidu)
models.notes: Heavier RT-DETR; more accurate, slower. Same ONNX/export shape as R50.

models.name: D-FINE-L (2024)
models.notes: Newer real-time DETR that beats RT-DETR on the accuracy/speed curve. Best free accuracy at real-time speed. Same DETR-style ONNX output as RT-DETR, so a cheap swap.

models.name: D-FINE-X (2024)
models.notes: Highest mAP of the free options; slower. Overkill unless we need max accuracy.

models.name: RF-DETR-base (Roboflow, 2025)
models.notes: 2025 real-time DETR, SOTA-ish, Apache-2.0. Similar ONNX integration to RT-DETR.

models.name: CNN detector (Apache-2.0)
models.map_note: representative of mature Apache-2.0 CNN detectors
models.notes: Mature Apache-2.0 CNN detectors are an easy commercial-free fallback; they detect the same 80 COCO classes but need an NMS step in post-processing and score a touch lower mAP than the DETR options. Some need an extra ONNX-export step depending on origin.
